items.q: Dickie Wells and George Joyce Treadwell. It was a nice little group, you know?

ctx.x: You were working with J. C. Heard and whom?

Let's see, I'll tell you who was in the band. Budd Johnson. Well, J. C. McKibbon Al McGiven (PHONETIC). Dickie Wells and George Joyce Treadwell. It was a nice little group, you know? And Eubie was -- he took -- I think he went to NYU before I did, and studied with Rudolph Schramm, the great Schillinger teacher, you know?
